PAPERS.title: Prenatal PM2.5 exposure drives epigenetic reprogramming of fetal macrophages linked to atopic dermatitis
PAPERS.pm: First-trimester ambient PM2.5, modelled residential
PAPERS.n: Birth-cohort AD risk paired with placental methylation and single-cell profiling; FCER1G hypomethylated in fetal macrophages, sustained overexpression persisting into M2 macrophages of AD skin and blood, driving NOX-dependent ROS and Th2 signalling

PAPERS.title: Association of long-term exposure to ambient air pollution and myopia in Chinese children
PAPERS.pm: 3-yr PM2.5 and components, ML model at school point
PAPERS.n: 212,566 students in grades 4-6, Tianjin; restricted cubic splines plus quartile modified Poisson, qgcomp for the mixture; sulfate carried the signal, OM/BC/NO3/NH4 weaker

PAPERS.title: Seasonal patterns and short-term environmental associations with AECOPD hospitalizations in Shijiazhuang, China, 2020-2024
PAPERS.pm: Daily PM2.5/PM10 city means; lags 0-7 and 7-day mean
PAPERS.n: 22,468 admissions from the municipal insurance database covering all tertiary, secondary and community hospitals; mean age 71.7 (SD 9.1), M:F 3.7:1; winter peak 6,009 vs summer 5,051

PAPERS.title: Acute controlled wood smoke exposure induces sensory airway irritation without detectable changes in small airway mechanics in healthy adults: a randomized crossover study
PAPERS.pm: Chamber PM1 453 +/- 13 ug m-3, 2 h vs filtered air
PAPERS.n: 14 healthy non-smokers (11 M, 3 F, mean 26 y), double-blind, 3-week washout; forced oscillometry (tremoFlo) plus spirometry and Borg symptom scoring; NCT03302117

PAPERS.title: The effect of in utero exposure to air pollution and subsequent cognitive and behavioral development in children aged 1-3 years old
PAPERS.pm: Prenatal PM2.5 and NO2 from public monitoring data
PAPERS.n: Stress in Pregnancy cohort, n=210, Queens NY; Bayley-III and ABAS-3 at 18, 24 and 36 months; PM2.5 deficits in boys (communication, social, gross motor), NO2 deficits in girls

PAPERS.title: Spatiotemporal variation of PM2.5 concentration and health impacts in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia: trends and patterns
PAPERS.pm: Hourly PM2.5, 7 low-cost sensors plus 2 BAM, 2022-23
PAPERS.n: Two-year hybrid network; site means 15-33 ug m-3, citywide 27 (5.4x the WHO AQG), 07:00 diurnal peak 38; HQ>1 in all age groups; DALYs monetised on a local VSL at USD 652.95 M, 0.25% of GDP

PAPERS.title: Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon (PAH) levels in indoor air and their associated health risks for children across Europe
PAPERS.pm: Active indoor air sampling plus deposited dust, 12 PAHs
PAPERS.n: Schools, homes and sports halls in Athens, Barcelona, Colchester, Copenhagen, Helsinki and Lisbon; medians >50,000 pg m-3 where residential wood burning dominates vs <10,000 in the south-west; ECR5 10^-8 to 10^-5

PAPERS.title: Impacts of long-range transport on the concentration, composition, and persistence of airborne fungi in northern Taiwan
PAPERS.pm: Daily culturable/spore fungal counts under ADS and FP
PAPERS.n: Wintertime daily monitoring, northern Taiwan; Asian dust storms vs frontal pollution contrasted against non-event days; ADS enriched Basidiospores and Cladosporium, FP enriched Aspergillus/Penicillium

PAPERS.title: Quantifying the reduction in particulate matter by urban park green spaces using a random forest model: a case study of Hohhot, China
PAPERS.pm: Six PM size fractions, summer daytime, in/out of park
PAPERS.n: 37 parks; linear vs GAM vs random forest under leave-one-park-out CV (point R2 0.19-0.58, park R2 0.18-0.72); SHAP plus PDP/ICE derivatives fixed nine driver thresholds beyond which mitigation plateaus

PAPERS.title: Metal contamination in residential snow and indoor dust near the Horne Smelter: a citizen-science study in Rouyn-Noranda, Quebec
PAPERS.pm: Cu, Pb, Cd, As, Zn, Cr in snow and settled indoor dust
PAPERS.n: 23 residences 540-2,080 m from Canada's only copper smelter, samples collected by residents; smelter distance plus wind direction explained 73% (Cu, Cr) to 44% (Zn) of snow variance and 36% to 15% of indoor dust variance

PAPERS.title: Determination of bismuth and bismuth telluride in workplace air by ultra microwave digestion with inductively coupled plasma optical emission spectrometry
PAPERS.journal: Zhonghua Lao Dong Wei Sheng Zhi Ye Bing Za Zhi
PAPERS.pm: MCE filter, 75 L; Bi and Te by ICP-OES after digestion
PAPERS.n: Ultra microwave digestion at 130 C for 10 min; linear 0.04-30 mg L-1 (r>0.9990); minimum detectable Bi2Te3 0.006 mg m-3 (via Bi) and 0.008 (via Te); digestion efficiency 99.1-100.0% Bi, 101.2-103.3% Te; Ag/Al/As non-interfering to 10 mg L-1

PAPERS.title: Exploring the targets and mechanisms of 6PPD-Q-induced cardiotoxicity: a network toxicology and molecular docking study
PAPERS.pm: No airborne metric; 6PPD-Q is a road-dust constituent
PAPERS.n: 144 putative targets, TP53 top hub; human AC16 cardiomyocytes, IC50 13.92 uM at 24 h; ROS accumulation, p53 Ser15 phosphorylation without TP53 transcriptional change, mitochondrial apoptosis and blocked late autophagic flux, all attenuated by pifithrin-alpha

PAPERS.title: Respiratory emergencies in disasters: a narrative review
PAPERS.pm: No new measurement; wildfire PM, silica and ash dust
PAPERS.n: Synthesis of PubMed/MEDLINE, Web of Science and Scopus with EM-DAT, WHO and UNDRR reports; unsystematic search with no stated inclusion criteria or risk-of-bias appraisal, so it indexes the literature rather than weighing it

PAPERS.title: Air quality in cities: what do sparse sensor networks miss?
PAPERS.pm: Fixed-station PM2.5 vs mobile within a 250 m radius
PAPERS.n: Three contrasting Boston Metro areas, spring and summer 2025; mean station-mobile difference 2.0 ug m-3 (median 1.5, IQR 0.6-2.8) but dynamic events exceeded 300% and 800 ug m-3; 10.4% of cases (21.8% at one site) crossed an AQI category boundary

PAPERS.title: BiLSTM with asymmetric Huber loss for 24 h PM2.5 forecasting and early exceedance detection at an industrial monitoring station in Bogota, Colombia
PAPERS.pm: Hourly PM2.5, Puente Aranda industrial corridor
PAPERS.n: n=31,961 hourly records, 2022-2025; asymmetric Huber loss, exceedance sample weighting and Optuna-TPE over 100 trials; 98.7% of WHO-exceeding days contain an hour above 25 ug m-3, median peak-to-mean 1.90

PAPERS.title: Temporal evolution and vertical distribution of size-resolved aerosol composition and mixing state within the boundary layer using an unmanned aerial vehicle
PAPERS.pm: Microscopy sampler on a UAV, 30 m and 1 min resolution
PAPERS.n: Over 100,000 particles by computer-controlled SEM with EDX in a coastal boundary layer; aged sea salt and dust (46-83%) gave way to organic-sulfur particles (57-89%), driving the mixing state index from 53% to 27%

PAPERS.title: Measurement report: impacts of thermodynamic and dynamic processes on the vertical distribution of carbonaceous aerosols: lessons from in-situ observations at the eastern foothills of Liupan Mountains, Loess Plateau
PAPERS.pm: eBC and UVPM profiles, tethered balloon, July 23 and 24
PAPERS.n: Two campaigns at Pingliang; near-surface eBC 0.84 and UVPM 1.24 ug m-3, both decreasing with height; UVPM exceeded eBC aloft overnight, attributed to nucleation from gaseous precursors; thermodynamics dominated near-surface transport, dynamics aloft drove horizontal dispersion

PAPERS.title: Impact of high-resolution soil erodibility datasets on dust simulations in WRF-Chem with the GOCART scheme
PAPERS.pm: Modelled PM10 vs SINQLAIR network, 5 dust episodes
PAPERS.n: EROD-HR (0.0625 deg global, 1 km Iberia) and SOILHD (1 km global, soil-texture-resolved, misclassified bare soil removed) over five 2022-2025 episodes; PM10 peak magnitude and timing improved inland, gains limited at coastal stations

PAPERS.title: Modelling mineral dust emissions from proglacial valleys of the St. Elias Mountains, Canada
PAPERS.pm: Modelled dust emission vs in situ, camera and Doppler
PAPERS.n: Sub-km WRF-Chem with glaciofluvial deposit heterogeneity and inundation explicitly treated; 5-19 d simulations across 2019-2022 gave 1.0e4 kg km-2 d-1 over 47 d; skill is season-dependent and the emission scheme stays sensitive to soil texture

PAPERS.title: Sampler-induced loss of respiratory virus infectivity revealed by spiked collection-liquid experiments
PAPERS.pm: Coriolis micro liquid impinger, spiked collection liquid
PAPERS.n: Rhinovirus, SARS-CoV-2 and influenza A spiked into collection liquid and run at several airflow rates; culturable virus fell up to 98.6% for SARS-CoV-2 and influenza A while RNA copies were largely unchanged; rhinovirus was near-unaffected
